messages:
deploybot: Release 2026.03.20-rc4 paused — env-parity check failed: secret 'PSK_ROTATION_ID' missing in prod and config key case mismatch (cache-prefix vs CachePrefix). See /ci/reports/2070012345
Jamal: paused? canary was green earlier
Sasha: yep canary passed but deploybot flagged prod env mismatch
Alex R.: what exactly is missing in prod?
releasebot: Diff summary:
```
staging: secrets.PSK_ROTATION_ID = 0xabc...
prod:   secrets.psk_rotation_id = <absent>
config: values.cache.prefix = "inference/kv/" vs values.CachePrefix = "inference/kv"
```
Lina: ugh casing again. Might be helm global-values override doing stringKey->snake_case
Sasha: this looks like the global-values merge we patched last week, but prod still has legacy overlay
Jamal: rollback? which image to pin?
Alex R.: suggest pin to image redwood/inference:2026.03.18-b2 (previous successful) — small risk
Sasha: prefer backfill secret in prod and re-run parity check. Backfill requires KMS approval (changes to key alias)
Jamal: KMS approval will need change window; next window 21:00 PT — ~2h wait
Lina: can we create an alias mirror temporarily? risky but faster
releasebot: Holds: deploy paused by parity check. Owner sign-off required: @SRE-oncall, @platform-eng
Sasha: I'll open a KMS emergency request and add release-note entry about aliasing risk
Jamal: if we delay, no immediate customer impact. ok to wait for change window
Alex R.: action items:
- Sasha: file KMS ticket KMS-4821 and request expedited change
- Lina: audit helm merges and create PR to normalize key names
- Jamal: prepare image pin PR as fallback
- deploybot: re-run parity checks after backfill
Sasha: filing ticket now — linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/KMS-4821
deploybot: Acknowledged — will re-check every 5m after secret appears
SRE-oncall: @Sasha seen, will monitor KMS ticket and standby for approval
Jamal: thanks — keep updates in this thread :thumbsup:
